2610.13494.title: Humanize MLE Agents: Multi-Agent Session Alternation Beyond Single-Agent Limits
2610.13494.paper_summary: Existing LLM-based agent approaches for long-horizon machine learning engineering (MLE) often use context engineering, implemented through custom harnesses that manage tools, skills, and accumulated experience. However, we find that as single-session execution lengthens, the agent's reasoning intensity declines alongside slowing progress, summarized as long-horizon deceleration, and the benefits of these custom harnesses vanish as the underlying model improves, summarized as harness staleness. These findings suggest that their benefits may not persist across versions, which motivates a workflow-level approach in which agents build on one another's work across sessions. We model these alternating agent sessions as a context-reset semi-Markov decision process (CR-SMDP) and establish sufficient conditions for alternation to exceed single-agent reference limits, derive an explicit experiment-budget bound, and characterize when session caps preserve this advantage. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Humanize MLE Agents (HMA), which alternates two agents on a shared workspace, limits each session to at most k experiments and resets the context between sessions, without additional task-specific harness or prior knowledge supplements. Across 75 Kaggle tasks in MLE-bench, HMA reaches a state-of-the-art any-medal rate of 78.2%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 8.0 points with a quarter of its time budget. Moreover, among six configurations spanning five heterogeneous agent pairs, HMA improves any-medal rate over the constituent baselines by 6.4 points on average, demonstrating cross-pair generality. A supplementary case on kernel optimization reaches 878 cycles, within 1.6% of the community leaderboard leader, demonstrating applicability beyond MLE.
2610.13494.paper_summary_zh: 現有基於 LLM 的長期機器學習工程 (MLE) 代理方法通常使用上下文工程，通過自定義的工具管理系統來實現，這些系統管理工具、技能和累積的經驗。<lb/>然而，我們發現隨著單次會話執行時間的延長，代理的推理強度下降，進展變慢，這被總結為長期減速，並且隨著基礎模型的改進，這些自定義工具的好處消失，這被總結為工具陳舊。<lb/>這些發現表明，它們的好處可能不會在不同版本之間持續存在，這促使了一種工作流程級別的方法，其中代理在會話之間建立彼此的工作。<lb/>我們將這些交替的代理會話建模為上下文重置半馬爾可夫決策過程 (CR-SMDP)，並確立了交替超過單一代理參考限制的充分條件，推導出明確的實驗預算界限，並描述何時會話上限能保持這一優勢。<lb/>在這一分析的指導下，我們引入了人性化 MLE 代理 (HMA)，該代理在共享工作空間上交替兩個代理，將每次會話限制為最多 k 次實驗，並在會話之間重置上下文，而不需要額外的特定任務工具或先前知識的補充。<lb/>在 MLE-bench 的 75 個 Kaggle 任務中，HMA 達到了 78.2% 的最先進任何獎牌率，超過了最強開源基準 8.0 點，且只用了一個四分之一的時間預算。<lb/>此外，在涵蓋五對異質代理的六種配置中，HMA 在構成基準上平均提高了 6.4 點的任何獎牌率，顯示出跨對的普遍性。<lb/>一個有關內核優化的補充案例達到了 878 週期，與社區排行榜的領導者相差 1.6%，顯示了其在 MLE 之外的適用性。
